response.sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Blank/Missing') AS hand FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM winners) SELECT w.hand, COUNT(*) AS winners, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / t.total AS share FROM winners w CROSS JOIN totals t GROUP BY w.hand, t.total ORDER BY winners DESC;
